meta.chapterLabel: Lesson 15: Talking about Preferences: I Like Japanese Anime (Extras)

items.reviewNote: Extras wave 2 (constructed for systematic coverage; job: vocabulary — the only sentence ダイビング appears in).
items.target: チャンさんはダイビングがすきです

items.note: たべます → たべる is Regular 2: ます simply becomes る, with no sound change before it.
items.reviewNote: Extras wave 2 (constructed for systematic coverage; job: forms — のが on a Regular 2 verb, the second of the chart's three classes).
items.target: エマさんはピザをたべるのがすきです

items.scene: answering "what kind of music do you like?"
items.reviewNote: Extras wave 1 (from the book: EXERCISES III substitution 3 answer; job: the only sentence ジャズ appears in).
items.target: ジャズがすきです

items.reviewNote: Extras wave 2 (constructed for systematic coverage; job: forms — fixed frame for the な-adjective grid, present affirmative).
items.target: ポールさんはやきゅうがすきです

items.note: Same frame, past negative: じゃありません picks up でした on the end. Nothing else in the sentence moves.
items.reviewNote: Extras wave 2 (constructed for systematic coverage; job: forms — the な-adjective grid's past negative had only the bare table entry, no sentence).
items.target: ポールさんはやきゅうがすきじゃありませんでした

items.reviewNote: Extras wave 2 (constructed for systematic coverage; job: forms — fixed frame for the じょうず grid, present negative).
items.target: すずきさんはダンスがじょうずじゃありません

items.english: What kind of music do you like?
items.reviewNote: Extras wave 1 (from the book: EXERCISES III substitution 3; job: the どんな turn on おんがく).
items.target: どんなおんがくがすきですか

items.note: が, not も: this is what you like, full stop. うたうのもすきです would mean singing is one MORE thing you like on top of something already mentioned.
items.reviewNote: Extras wave 2 (constructed for systematic coverage; job: particles — minimal pair against the base lesson's うたうのもすきです).
items.target: うたうのがすきです

items.note: This の joins two nouns: いとこ の ポール, "Paul, [who is] my cousin." It is the same の as にほんのアニメ, and NOT the nominalizer の of かくのがすきです — that one only ever follows a verb.
items.reviewNote: Extras wave 1 (from the book: Target Dialogue; job: possessive/appositive の, and the contrast with this lesson's nominalizer の).
items.target: いとこのポールです

items.english: Paul-san and Suzuki-san like mecha anime.
items.note: と joins the two people into one topic, so は marks them both and the sentence takes a single すきです.
items.reviewNote: Extras wave 1 (from the book: Target Dialogue closing summary; job: と joining subjects inside the person は thing が frame).
items.target: ポールさんとすずきさんはロボットのアニメがすきです

items.english: Do you like drawing pictures, Green-san?
items.note: え is what かく takes as its object (を), and the whole action えをかく is what の turns into the thing liked (が). Two different particles, two different jobs.
items.reviewNote: Extras wave 1 (from the book: EXERCISES VII substitution 2; job: を inside a のが clause, the pattern's hardest shape).
items.target: グリーンさんはえをかくのがすきですか

items.scene: answering "what kind of anime do you like?"
items.note: ロボットのアニメ is literally "robot anime" — の narrows the noun that follows it.
items.reviewNote: Extras wave 1 (from the book: Target Dialogue, Paul's answer; job: the answer half of どんな〜がすきですか).
items.target: ロボットのアニメがすきです

items.note: Same frame, negated: です becomes じゃありません. A な-adjective never takes くない.
items.reviewNote: Extras wave 2 (constructed for systematic coverage; job: forms — fixed frame for the な-adjective grid, present negative).
items.target: ポールさんはやきゅうがすきじゃありません

items.english: Do you like Italian food, Suzuki-san?
items.reviewNote: Extras wave 1 (from the book: EXERCISES III substitution 2; job: the first turn of the substitution dialogue).
items.target: すずきさんはイタリアりょうりがすきですか

items.english: I like it too. I also like swimming.
items.scene: replying after the other person says they like running
items.note: Two も in one turn: the first agrees about running, the second adds swimming.
items.reviewNote: Extras wave 1 (from the book: EXERCISES VII substitution 1; job: the second half of the substitution, uncarded).
items.target: わたしもすきです。およぐのもすきです

items.english: What kind of sports do you like?
items.note: どんな + noun + がすきですか narrows a category you have already established the person likes.
items.reviewNote: Extras wave 1 (from the book: EXERCISES III example and SPEAKING PRACTICE 1; job: the どんな question on スポーツ, carded only for アニメ and くだもの).
items.target: どんなスポーツがすきですか

items.note: うた is the noun "song", so it takes が directly. うたうのがじょうずです — with the verb — says the same thing about the ACT of singing.
items.reviewNote: Extras wave 2 (constructed for systematic coverage; job: vocabulary — the only sentence うた appears in, plus the noun/verb contrast).
items.target: かとうさんはうたがじょうずです

items.note: Regular 1: よみます → よむ. The み before ます becomes む.
items.reviewNote: Extras wave 1 (from the book: EXERCISES V item 10, which asks for this form; job: a dictionary form the exercise names and no card carried).
items.target: よむ

items.reviewNote: Extras wave 2 (constructed for systematic coverage; job: vocabulary — the only sentence ウイスキー appears in).
items.target: ブラウンさんはウイスキーがすきじゃありません

items.note: The lesson's core frame: person は — thing が — すきです. にほんの here means "of Japan", i.e. Japanese.
items.reviewNote: Extras wave 1 (from the book: Target Dialogue, Paul's line; job: the lesson's headline sentence, uncarded).
items.target: わたしはにほんのアニメがすきです

items.note: Contrast with サッカーをみるのがすきです: this one likes the SPORT, that one likes WATCHING it. A plain noun takes が on its own; an action needs のが to become one.
items.reviewNote: Extras wave 2 (constructed for systematic coverage; job: particles — minimal pair against the base lesson's サッカーをみるのがすきです).
items.target: サッカーがすきです

items.english: Do you like going to art museums, Emma-san?
items.note: に stays with いく inside the clause; の then wraps the whole action so が can mark it.
items.reviewNote: Extras wave 2 (constructed for systematic coverage; job: particles — に surviving inside a のが clause, in question form).
items.target: エマさんはびじゅつかんにいくのがすきですか

items.note: Same frame in the past: です becomes でした.
items.reviewNote: Extras wave 2 (constructed for systematic coverage; job: forms — the な-adjective grid's past affirmative had only the bare table entry すきでした, no sentence).
items.target: ポールさんはやきゅうがすきでした

items.reviewNote: Extras wave 2 (constructed for systematic coverage; job: forms — fixed frame for the じょうず grid, past affirmative).
items.target: すずきさんはダンスがじょうずでした

items.note: The same のが clause works with じょうず as with すき: verb in dictionary form, then のが. はしります → はしる is Regular 1.
items.reviewNote: Extras wave 2 (constructed for systematic coverage; job: forms — のが with じょうず, which the grammar states and no card showed).
items.target: ラジャさんははしるのがじょうずです

items.note: します → する is Irregular, the third class in the chart along with きます → くる.
items.reviewNote: Extras wave 2 (constructed for systematic coverage; job: forms — のが on an Irregular verb, completing the chart's three classes).
items.target: たなかさんはスポーツをするのがすきです

items.note: じょうず takes が for the skill, exactly as すき takes が for the thing liked.
items.reviewNote: Extras wave 2 (constructed for systematic coverage; job: forms — fixed frame for the じょうず grid, present affirmative; also the only sentence ダンス appears in).
items.target: すずきさんはダンスがじょうずです

items.note: Regular 1: あるきます → あるく. The き before ます becomes く.
items.reviewNote: Extras wave 1 (from the book: EXERCISES V item 9, which asks for this form; job: a dictionary form the exercise names and no card carried).
items.target: あるく

items.scene: answering "what kind of Italian food do you like?"
items.reviewNote: Extras wave 1 (from the book: EXERCISES III substitution 2 answer; job: the only sentence ピザ appears in).
items.target: ピザがすきです

items.english: What kind of Italian food do you like?
items.reviewNote: Extras wave 1 (from the book: EXERCISES III substitution 2; job: the どんな turn).
items.target: どんなイタリアりょうりがすきですか

items.scene: praising someone's drawing as you watch them finish it
items.note: じょうず is only ever said about OTHER people. Japanese speakers avoid it about themselves or their own family because it sounds like boasting — which is also why じょうずですか is rarely asked.
items.reviewNote: Extras wave 1 (from the book: Target Dialogue, Smith and Paul's line; job: the GRAMMAR 1 note on じょうず, which no card carried).
items.target: じょうずですね

items.note: りょうり on its own is "cooking" or "cuisine"; にほんの narrows it, the same way イタリアりょうり does.
items.reviewNote: Extras wave 2 (constructed for systematic coverage; job: vocabulary — the only sentence the bare りょうり appears in).
items.target: にほんのりょうりがすきです

items.note: みるの turns the verb into the thing liked — the nominalizer only ever follows a dictionary form. Contrast にほんのアニメ, where の joins two nouns instead.
items.reviewNote: Extras wave 2 (constructed for systematic coverage; job: particles — minimal pair against わたしはにほんのアニメがすきです, the possessive の).
items.target: アニメをみるのがすきです

items.scene: answering "what kind of sports do you like?"
items.reviewNote: Extras wave 1 (from the book: EXERCISES III example answer; job: the answer half, and the only sentence やきゅう appears in).
items.target: やきゅうがすきです

items.reviewNote: Extras wave 2 (constructed for systematic coverage; job: vocabulary — the only sentence スキー appears in).
items.target: なかむらさんはスキーがじょうずです

items.scene: after agreeing you like the same anime the other person does
items.note: かくの is "drawing" — the nominalizer の turns the dictionary form into something が/も can mark. も (not が) because it is one MORE thing you like.
items.reviewNote: Extras wave 1 (from the book: Target Dialogue, Suzuki's line; job: のも, the nominalizer under a second particle).
items.target: かくのもすきです

items.note: The longest form in the set, and still only the ending changes: じょうず + じゃありません + でした.
items.reviewNote: Extras wave 2 (constructed for systematic coverage; job: forms — the じょうず grid's past negative had only the bare table entry, no sentence).
items.target: すずきさんはダンスがじょうずじゃありませんでした
